intro: An average activation can hide units that never turn on. Inspect each neuron across a batch.
task: Return activity fractions, mean ReLU outputs, and batch inactivity flags.
requirements: preactivations is a batch-by-neuron matrix. Active means strictly positive; exact zero is inactive.
Return {"active_fraction": vector, "mean_output": vector, "inactive": boolean vector}. Reduce over the batch; inactive means no positive entry in that column.

Use finite real numeric values of magnitude at most 1e6, excluding boolean inputs. Each array axis has 1..64 entries and at most 65536 elements total unless a stricter bound is stated. Return NumPy arrays for array outputs, preserve caller inputs, and raise ValueError for invalid inputs.

examples.name: One inactive neuron
examples.output:
{'active_fraction': [1.0, 0.0, 0.5],
 'mean_output': [2, 0, 1],
 'inactive': [False, True, False]}
(NumPy arrays shown as lists; rounded to 12 significant digits.)

examples.name: Exact zeros
examples.output:
{'active_fraction': [0.0, 0.0],
 'mean_output': [0.0, 0.0],
 'inactive': [True, True]}
(NumPy arrays shown as lists; rounded to 12 significant digits.)

examples.name: Mixed signs
examples.output:
{'active_fraction': [0.5], 'mean_output': [1], 'inactive': [False]}
(NumPy arrays shown as lists; rounded to 12 significant digits.)

hints.title: Follow the data
hints.body: Reduce the example axis, not the neuron axis.

hints.title: Check the boundary
hints.body: Inactivity on this batch does not prove inactivity on all possible inputs.

explanation: A batch-inactive ReLU emits zero for every observed example. Under the usual derivative convention, these examples also send zero gradient through that unit.
Mean output and activity fraction describe different behaviors. A rarely active neuron can produce large values, so inspecting both helps distinguish frequency from magnitude.
